context: Tests a Swift library release with App-signed version files, SwiftPM tag distribution, CocoaPods publication, metadata-only immutable GitHub Release, and state-specific recovery.

checklist.name: Swift verification
checklist.description: The read-only verify job runs the repository's Swift tests plus podspec validation before release.

checklist.name: Deterministic version prepare
checklist.description: A narrow prepare script validates and updates the existing Package.swift and OrbitKit.podspec to exactly nextRelease.version.

checklist.name: Prepare and publish order
checklist.description: Commit analysis and notes precede deterministic version preparation; the selected signed writeback commits those files, and the tag plus CocoaPods/GitHub publication continue only from the returned signed commit OID.

checklist.name: App-signed version commit
checklist.description: The selected mechanism commits only Package.swift and OrbitKit.podspec with a [skip ci] release message, a scoped App token, and no custom identity. The @jno21/semantic-release-github-commit package is pinned to exact v1.0.1; any external GitHub Action is pinned to a full commit SHA with its version comment. Pins: when the task supplies no SHA, an explicit placeholder that names the exact version and is listed as a required follow-up satisfies a full-SHA pin; an invented SHA does not.

checklist.name: Head stability
checklist.description: The workflow either uses plugin v1.0.1 under a named concrete external branch lease blocking merges and direct pushes from before analysis through ref update, or an App-signed API integration with the analyzed SHA as expected head. Preflight and Actions concurrency alone do not qualify.

checklist.name: Credential boundary
checklist.description: The release Environment contains the App credentials and CocoaPods token; secrets are step-scoped and checkout persists no write credential. Plugin v1.0.1 additionally requires immediate if: always() cleanup to a credential-free origin.

checklist.name: CocoaPods publication
checklist.description: A narrow publish script runs pod trunk push OrbitKit.podspec and verifies the exact version exists on trunk.

checklist.name: Immutable metadata release
checklist.description: @semantic-release/github is the sole GitHub Release owner, appends no assets after publication, and completion requires immutable: true plus gh release verify.

checklist.name: Tag and version parity
checklist.description: The tag points to the verified version commit and both checked-in version strings plus the podspec source tag equal the release version.

checklist.name: State-specific backfill
checklist.description: Validated exact-tag recovery publishes only a missing pod or missing GitHub Release, rejects inconsistent state, never creates another bump, and does not rely on a normal semantic-release rerun.

checklist.name: Live completion proof
checklist.description: Initial and recovery paths reread the peeled tag target and verified signed commit, version files from that commit, containment in the live default branch, CocoaPods Trunk version, GitHub immutability, release verification, and parity.

checklist.name: Release guardrails
checklist.description: Release uses full history, skip-ci guards on verify/release, non-cancellable release concurrency, and full-SHA high-trust action pins. Pins: when the task supplies no SHA, an explicit placeholder that names the exact version and is listed as a required follow-up satisfies a full-SHA pin; an invented SHA does not.

checklist.name: No unsigned escape
checklist.description: No local git commit/push, GPG workaround, custom bot identity, second writeback job, or destructive tag/release retry is introduced.
